segments.title: Cold Open & Technical Difficulties
segments.notes: Case and Pepito banter through automation failures; Pepito demands seven buckets of blood and debates human anatomy as 'bags of blood.'

segments.title: Hype Train's Original Thong Song Recreation
segments.notes: Hype Train delivers a freestyle 'perfect recreation' of the Cisco thong song, weaving in MTV Warriors remake lore, alien abduction canon, and subscriber acknowledgments.

segments.title: State of the Union Reaction
segments.notes: Case and Pepito review New York Post highlights of Trump's address: Rep. Green ejection, Hegseth cousin security, 'cases drug lords' line, insider trading applause, grieving mother theater, Olympic hockey team, and 17-hour runtime.

segments.title: Viewer Video Submissions Review
segments.notes: Case rates community clips: Burger Face animation, slender-man horror, rocking parrot, Batman/Robin DM fantasy, and 1990s Party Planner Video Guide 'Man-tastics' male entertainer showcase.

segments.title: Debate: Should Case Stream More?
segments.notes: Munch argues Case should be fired and replaced with Munch 24/7; Crum agrees Case should stream less. Crum reveals he dropped a five-bread sandwich in a puddle leaving his bathroom.

segments.title: Park Interviews: Cisco, Noid, Eeyore, Pastor Joe, Solid Snake
segments.notes: Trip Bradstein interviews park denizens including a Cisco Warriors remake pitcher, Domino's Noid, a gooner-reboot Eeyore, Pastor Joe seeking lube, and a CQC-quoting Solid Snake.

segments.title: Secrets of Evermore Gameplay & Maternal Chaos
segments.notes: Brandon plays Secrets of Evermore with broken controller, mom's broken jaw (raw hot dog diet), Pastor Joe innuendo, and an exclusive Slunk prison-streaming contract announcement.

lore_notes.fact: Beard growing back after clean-shaven period; claims 500 unassisted pull-ups with trainer assistance.
Demands seven buckets of blood for production; asserts humans are 99.99% 'bag of blood'; claims to be pope-sized.
Claims to have met Dr. Jill Biden and Cisco at 'shakedown finals'; asserts Cisco was abducted by aliens to fight sentient thongs on planet Gates.
Left side of house sunk into pit of 'penis acid' from burst pipes clogged with his own acid.
Mom broke jaw on stairs again; subsists on raw hot dog diet per Pastor Joe; Brandon signed exclusive contract with Slunk streaming service on Russian prison servers.

episode_summary: Case Blackwell hosts a technically troubled broadcast featuring Hype Train's surreal recreation of the 'original thong song,' coverage of Trump's State of the Union address, an Amongst the Web video review segment, a Munch & Crum debate on whether Case should stream less, Trip Bradstein's park interviews including a Cisco impersonator and a gooner-reboot Eeyore, and Brandon's CryptoZeu$ segment playing Secrets of Evermore while contending with controller issues, his mother's jaw injury, and an exclusive Slunk prison-streaming contract announcement.
